commands: python3 scripts/nav_wrappers.py collect --parts yahoo1h --symbols <29 tickers, see raw/collect_manifest.json>
uv run --with pytest --with pycryptodome python -m pytest scripts/test_nav_wrappers.py -q

data_sources.yahoo: query1.finance.yahoo.com v8 chart, daily from 2015 for 23 trusts, 41 DATs, FX and references; 60-minute bars (last 728 days) for 29 tickers; UA Mozilla/5.0. Yahoo scales GBTC/ETHE closes before the 2024 Mini Trust spin-offs by ~0.9: undone (curated.json yahoo_unadjust).
data_sources.sec: data.sec.gov XBRL company facts and submissions (filing index) for 64 CIKs and efts.sec.gov full-text index, UA "llm-quant research" (no e-mail). GAP: www.sec.gov (filing documents, company_tickers) refused this UA ("Undeclared Automated Tool"), so filing texts were not read; their content is cited from press releases and news, and dates from the EDGAR index.
data_sources.binance: api.binance.com spot 1h klines and fapi.binance.com funding for 33 coins from 2019 (perp 1h for HYPE; 1000BONK scaled). TON spot and perp stop on 2026-06-30 / 2026-06-23 (CoinGecko daily price used after; no hedge leg).
data_sources.coingecko: public API: treasury lists per coin, entity list and records, 365-day holdings charts (the public API refuses longer), TON daily prices; paced at >= 8 s.
data_sources.strategytracker: data.strategytracker.com public dataset version 20261010T171907Z: daily BTC balance and share counts for 20 BTC treasuries with statement links; preferred-series histories (from 2026-03 for MSTR); Metaplanet debt summary. Its MSTR mNAV ignores debt and preferred (debt 0, cash 0).
data_sources.strategy: api.strategy.com/btc/mstrKpiData (live: price, market cap, EV, debt, preferred; fetched 2026-10-10 17:22 UTC).
data_sources.web: event dates and figures from press releases and news (URLs below), each EDGAR-dated where the company files (analysis.json dats.events[].edgar).

curated: research/2026-10-10/nav_wrappers/curated.json (trust events, Mini Trust distributions, Yahoo un-adjustment, DAT events, capital overrides, stale-dashboard checks) and universe.json

protocol.trusts: entry variants chosen on GBTC/ETHE (filed 2021, 2023), tested once on 2024-26 conversions; daily rules (8 variants x 2 hedges) chosen on 2019-09..2024-12, tested 2025-01..2026-10 through backtest.choose_then_test
protocol.dats: weekly signals from 2025-11; 18 variants (x in 0.5..1.0, k in 20/40/65 days) per signal/hedge, chosen on signal weeks before 2026-04-01 by NW t, tested on the rest; robustness without names whose holdings fail the 10-Q check; event windows chosen on events before 2026-01-01

verification.trusts: coin per share (10-Q/10-K XBRL) x Binance at 16:00 New York vs the sponsor NAV per share: median abs error 0.03-0.44% over 4-27 quarter-ends per trust (tables.md A1)
verification.dat_holdings: 10-Q crypto fair value / coin price vs dashboard holdings for 24 DATs; mismatches recorded in curated.json stale_dashboard_checks

gaps: www.sec.gov filing documents refused the required UA; no filing text was read directly
non-reporting OTC trusts (MANA, FILG, GLIV, GBAT, STCK, DEFG, OBNB, OBNK; GSNR has no XBRL): no coin per share; Grayscale/Osprey sites refuse automated access (429/403)
basket trusts (GDLC, BITW, DEFG): quarter-end NAV only, no daily NAV and no event returns; GDLC shows -15.6% at 2025-12-31 while listed (unexplained)
DAT holdings before 2025-10 only from XBRL; CoinGecko history capped at 365 days; DefiLlama treasury API is paid; bitcointreasuries history behind login
Metaplanet debt/preferred history unreliable (dashboard); excluded from the panel; live values from the dashboard summary
no look-through series for CEPO (SPAC), SQNS (20-F), H100, ETHM, ALTS, AVX, ZONE, USDE, MPU
XXI has no instant share count in XBRL; live share count from CoinGecko
borrow cost / availability for shorting premium DATs or trusts not measured (only long-discount trades tested)
hourly late-entry measured only as the first-hour share of event-day moves (Yahoo 60m bars, 20 events)
